label: Root links from Alexander Bird, Antidotes all the way down? Theoria 19
summary: §6, pp.267–268, dispositional essentialism and laws: Bird proposes explaining suitable laws through dispositions essential to natural properties and conditions for their manifestation. This is a rival account of lawhood to best-system regularities. Applying it to the same laws would require defending dispositional essentialism and the specified exception conditions. No defeat of best-system lawhood is asserted.
